comments.author: @AirCargoHeavy
comments.text:
As an American, I’m so thankful to be free and blessed.  Free people must pray for their fellow man all over the world.  We take for granted the small things people need, like clean water.  

It’s shocking to see how desperate people are, just for basic things like sewage handling, food for their families and animals, and clean air and water.

Please pray for those in need around the world, AND be thankful.  Those of us in the West, those of us who are blessed, those of us who are free…please pray.

How horrible that mankind, created in the image of God, lives like this.
